blocks.text:
## The 3 Guianas in one journey

Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana are neighbours, yet each has a distinct character.

Guyana combines English-speaking Caribbean culture, Indigenous heritage and vast stretches of rainforest. The programme's main natural highlight is Kaieteur Falls.

Suriname offers Paramaribo's wooden colonial architecture and the cultures of Javanese, African, Indian, Maroon and Indigenous communities.

French Guiana brings together Creole culture, French colonial heritage, Amazonian nature and modern space infrastructure in Kourou.
